question: What power over the cosmos results from possessing this talisman?
premises: The practitioner becomes endowed with all sovereignties
The three worlds are the target of control
Bringing them under control is the prescribed outcome
inference: Possessing the talisman enables the practitioner to gain all sovereignties and subjugate the three worlds.
plain_english: Having become endowed with all sovereignties, one should bring the three worlds under control.
